name: Fresh Fruit Platter with Dip
description: A colorful and refreshing fruit platter served with a creamy vanilla pudding dip, optionally flavored with Grand Marnier.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups milk (or a combination of 1 cup milk and ½ cup sour cream)
1 Tbsp Grand Marnier (or other favorite liquor/liqueur), optional
Assorted fresh fruit (e.g., strawberries, bananas, grapes, apple slices, orange slices, melon)

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare the vanilla pudding according to the package instructions using either 1½ cups of milk or the specified combination of milk and sour cream.
Mix equal parts of the prepared pudding and Cool Whip until well blended.
If using, add Grand Marnier or other liquor/liqueur and blend well into the pudding mixture.
Chill the dip in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Arrange a selection of fresh fruit on a platter, alternating between contrasting colors for visual appeal.
Serve the chilled dip alongside the fresh fruit platter.

keywords: fresh fruit platter, vanilla pudding dip, Cool Whip, Grand Marnier, healthy appetizer

_similar.name: Pina Colada Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and tropical dip made with pineapple, coconut pudding, and sour cream, perfect for serving with fresh fruit.
recipeIngredient: 3½ oz package instant coconut pudding and pie filling (or 1 vanilla pudding and ¼ cup shredded coconut with coconut extract)

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth.
Refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled with a variety of fresh fruits.

_similar.name: Fluffy Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A light and airy fruit dip made with softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.

recipeInstructions.text: In a bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.
Mix until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with your choice of fresh fruit.

_similar.name: Pork Chops with Dried Fruit
_similar.description: A savory and sweet dish featuring pork chops cooked with assorted dried fruits in a flavorful orange juice sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups assorted dried fruit (apples, peaches, pears, apricots, raisins)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil and cook pork chops until golden brown on each side, about 6 to 8 minutes per side. Remove chops to a plate.
Reduce heat, add 1 cup orange juice to the skillet, and scrape any browned bits from the pan. Bring to a boil.
Add the remaining orange juice, dried fruit, Worcestershire sauce, and allspice. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with a small amount of water or juice. Stir into the skillet and cook until the sauce thickens, about 15 minutes.
Return pork chops to the skillet and cook until heated through. Serve with rice or couscous.

_similar.keywords: pork chops, dried fruit, orange juice sauce, savory sweet dish

_similar.name: Orange Jello Salad
_similar.description: A simple orange Jello salad with mandarin oranges and Dream Whip.
recipeIngredient: 1 small package Dream Whip (not pudding or instant vanilla)

recipeInstructions.text: Put the first 3 ingredients into a saucepan and cook until clear.
Cool the mixture.
Mix Dream Whip according to package instructions.
Drain oranges and add Dream Whip and oranges to the cooled mixture.
Allow to cool completely before serving.

_similar.keywords: orange Jello salad, mandarin oranges, Dream Whip

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread
